retrieved.title: 采访布光：单一柔光主光

request:
镜头 s27：纪录片采访镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-int78）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', '50mm']）：Locked look "2078 oral-history interview" (style preset sp01-int78): a Sony FX6 on a locked tripod; S-Cinetone; a 50mm prime at f/2.8; filter Black Pro-Mist 1/8; grade: neutral, gently warm skin, background one to two stops under the face; light: one large soft key 45 degrees from frame left, negative fill on the right, a small warm practical in the background; texture: clean, fine detail, real skin texture; a calm, restrained oral-history interview, the subject looking past the lens.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary talking-head interview, tripod camera, subject looks past the lens at the interviewer
导演意图（自然语言）：采访固定机位。波爷坐在椅子上，双手捧着那只旧铁盒放在腿上，拇指擦了擦盒盖，抬头慢慢说。环境声：安静房间的底噪。
情绪：regretful, steadfast, quiet
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, locked-off interview camera
景深与虚实：Shallow depth of field; his face and the box sharp, background soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Oral-history interview medium shot: Boye, 64, sits on the metal chair holding the old dented tin box with its short antenna in his lap, both hands around it; the box now carries a small red-and-white smiley sticker. Blocking lock: Boye sits at frame centre on the metal chair, the tin box in his lap in the lower centre of frame; dim room behind him.
Picture 2: Boye, 'Grandpa Bo' (61, male, old network protocol engineer) (character reference; role: the mentor). A 61-year-old Chinese man, retired network protocol engineer who now runs a repair stall. Short grey-white beard, thinning grey hair, black-framed glasses with one temple wrapped in tape, deep wrinkles, gentle stubborn expression. Faded dark navy quilted cotton jacket over a brown knitted vest, a soldering-stained apron.
Picture 3: the handmade ANET node box with the smiley sticker (prop reference; role: prop reference). Close-up product-less documentary photo of a handmade network node device on a workbench: an old dented steel ammunition tin fitted with a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny indicator LEDs (two red, one white) and a short screw-on antenna. On its lid is a slightly worn sticker that reproduces exactly the smiley speech-bubble logo from the reference image. Solder wire and a multimeter beside it.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) — 波爷（六十多岁老人的声音，缓慢、沙哑）: 钥匙，是我们亲手交出去的。他这只盒子，我留了十七年。
现场环境声：quiet room tone
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-interview] 机位：采访固定机位
[ours/sound-room] 声音：采访间底噪
[rules/move/locked-off] move
[ours/light-interview-key] 采访布光：单一柔光主光
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot, locked-off tripod camera, absolutely static for the whole take, Boye framed at frame centre with nose room toward frame left. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Boye seated on the metal chair at frame centre, the old dented tin box held in both hands in his lap in the lower centre of the frame, the dim room soft and empty behind him, nothing in the foreground. Start: he sits still, shoulders slightly stooped, looking down at the box; his right thumb moves across the lid in two slow strokes, feeling the dents and the edge of the worn smiley sticker. Middle: he draws a breath, lifts his chin and raises his eyes past the lens toward frame left, the small soft catchlight coming up in his glasses, his fingers closing a little tighter around the tin; he speaks slowly, then pauses and settles his jaw. End: his thumb comes to rest flat on the lid, he gives one small nod as if confirming something to himself, and holds there, still looking past the lens, the box steady in his lap. Mood: regretful, steadfast, quiet. Blur: his face, beard, glasses and the box stay sharp with fine skin and steel texture; the dim room behind him falls softly out of focus, the warm practical dissolving into a small soft glow. Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) says, <d>[Chinese] 钥匙，是我们亲手交出去的。他这只盒子，我留了十七年。</d> Final line of this shot: end on "我留了十七年", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.
